purpose: Artistic depth-map style transfers; illustrative, not measured sensor data.

prompts.name: ports
prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: landscape website application image, 3:2 aspect ratio. Edit the provided online photograph into a sophisticated monochrome depth-map visualization. Preserve the actual composition, structures and perspective. Replace all photographic colors and lighting with smooth depth-based grayscale: near surfaces light silver, far surfaces charcoal, distant sky nearly black, crisp object silhouettes and subtle relief-like separation. Use a dark charcoal and silver palette that belongs on a #05080d website. This must look like a depth-estimation render, not simply a desaturated photo, not line art. No labels, lettering, legends, grids, overlays or watermarks. Keep the full scene, no frame or border. Preserve the container terminal, diagonal jetty, gantry cranes and distant harbor. Highlight ONLY the pair of gantry cranes at the end of the diagonal jetty in orange #ff6a2b, carefully following their real silhouettes. All other objects remain monochrome.

prompts.name: environment
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape website application image, 3:2 aspect ratio, for an Environmental monitoring & restoration tile. Create a completely new sophisticated depth-estimation render of a coastal seagrass restoration survey, seen from a high oblique aerial viewpoint. A small autonomous monitoring sailboat crosses the scene above long organic bands of restored seagrass and shallow tidal channels; the boat is the clear focal point and reads as a purposeful environmental survey vessel. Style/medium: cinematic technical depth-map visualization, not a photograph and not line art; smooth charcoal-to-silver relief shading with crisp large-scale forms and restrained fine texture, consistent with premium marine engineering imagery. Composition/framing: wide 3:2 composition; clear foreground, midground and background depth layers for a subtle parallax effect; the boat near the lower-right third with open water and sweeping seagrass bands leading through the frame; no frame or border. Lighting/mood: dark, calm, precise, scientific; near surfaces pale silver, deeper channels charcoal, distant water nearly black. Color palette: monochrome charcoal and silver, with ONLY the entire monitoring sailboat highlighted in vivid safety orange #ff6a2b, retaining subtle tonal depth and clean silhouette. Constraints: no text, labels, legends, grids, UI overlays, people, logos or watermark; do not resemble coral heads or the previous top-down reef image; no photographic blue or green; keep the orange confined to the vessel; subject silhouettes must remain legible when cropped to a 3:2 website card.
